newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar unit files $2.5 bln debt shelf.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar unit files $2.5 bln debt shelf.

text.p: Caterpillar Financial Services Corp registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer up to $2.5 billion in debt securities.
The Caterpillar Inc unit said proceeds would be used for financing of future sales and leasing transactions for customers and dealer loans, and for other corporate purposes.

The filing said the company expects to incur additional debt in connection with its financing operations. The amount, timing and nature of the debt have not yet been determined and will depend on the volume of the company's business, availability of credit and general market conditions, the filing said.
